ada.notes: The DOJ's 2024 Title II rule adopts WCAG 2.1 Level AA as the technical standard for state/local government web content. Title III (private businesses) has no codified technical standard, but WCAG 2.1 AA is the de facto benchmark used in enforcement and settlements.

section-508.notes: The 2018 Section 508 Refresh incorporates WCAG 2.0 Level A and AA by reference (36 CFR 1194.1, Appendix A) for federal ICT.

eaa.notes: The European Accessibility Act (Directive (EU) 2019/882) is implemented via harmonized standard EN 301 549, which itself incorporates WCAG 2.1 Level AA success criteria for web content. EN 301 549 also imposes requirements outside WCAG's scope (hardware, non-web software, support services).
additionalRequirements: EN 301 549 clause 9-11: web/software/documentation conformance beyond WCAG success criteria
